_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#18. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 writes the zero right-hand side with dune.ufl.Constant components in the slot where the base run writes Python zeros, so the components carry a domain. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
